title.narrative: Support to the Climate Action Team of the United Nations Secretary-General

description.narrative: Building on the Paris Agreement, commitments to address climate change have accelerated throughout recent Climate Action Summits, COPs, the SDG Moments and the Financing for Development in the Era of COVID-19 and Beyond Initiative. And yet, there was significant work left to close the gaps on mitigation, adaptation and finance, both in terms of commitment and implementation. It is within this context that the Climate Action Team, located within the Executive Office of the United Nations Secretary-General, expanded the Secretary-General’s global leadership to accelerate ambition and implementation on climate change in four key areas. Commitments and coalitions for a just energy transition and emissions reductions were strengthened. Climate change adaptation finance was mobilised and private finance in particular were tapped for a climate-resilient transition. Stakeholder engagement was also promoted and the credibility of non-state actors’ support strengthened.
